name: 100ms Video SDK
description_en:
100ms supplies live audio/video infrastructure for developers building calls, classrooms, streams and other real-time experiences inside their applications. SDKs expose integration controls, while Prebuilt supplies a configurable video interface and hosted-room experience. It is not simply a subscription for employees to join a finished office-meeting application.

Rooms inherit behavior from templates and roles. A host and an audience member may join the same room with different publishing or moderation permissions. The homepage also links to a separate healthcare AI business at 100ms.ai; that does not make every healthcare-agent capability part of the video SDK.
description_zh:
100ms 为开发者提供实时音视频基础设施，用于在应用内构建通话、教室、直播等体验。SDK 提供集成控制，Prebuilt 提供可配置的视频界面与托管房间体验。它不只是供员工使用成品办公会议应用的订阅。

房间行为来自模板与角色，同房间的主持人与观众可具有不同发布或管理权限。首页还连接至 100ms.ai 的独立医疗 AI 业务，不能因此把所有医疗代理能力并入视频 SDK。

core_features.explanation_en: Prebuilt supplies components for preview, room, chat and participant display within an application.
core_features.explanation_zh: Prebuilt 为应用提供预览、房间、聊天及参与者界面组件。

core_features.explanation_en: Conferencing, streaming, encoding and recording have distinct billing meters.
core_features.explanation_zh: 会议、直播、编码和录制具有不同计量。

sections.title_en: Example: a tutor, learners and a room template
sections.title_zh: 示例：教师、学生与房间模板
sections.en:
A learning application can create a template for a classroom, decide which roles may publish and moderate, then embed Prebuilt or a platform SDK. The documentation recommends experiencing the room from each role’s point of view. A learner’s hidden control is not itself proof that the server rejects a prohibited action; permissions need an actual integration test.

Prepare an account, template, room-joining mechanism and the chosen client platform. Evaluate camera/microphone refusal, host departure and a rejoining participant as well as a successful call. These are developer acceptance suggestions, not tests performed here.
sections.zh:
教学应用可以创建教室模板，决定哪些角色可发布与管理，再嵌入 Prebuilt 或对应平台 SDK。文档建议分别从各角色视角进入房间。学生界面隐藏控制，不等于已证明服务端拒绝越权动作，权限需要实际集成测试。

应准备账户、模板、进房方式及所选客户端平台。除成功通话外，还应评估拒绝摄像头/麦克风、主持人离开及参与者重新加入。本次未执行这些开发验收建议。

sections.title_en: Participant minutes differ from room minutes
sections.title_zh: 参与者分钟不同于房间分钟
sections.en:
The pricing page includes 10,000 conferencing minutes monthly and then displays $0.004 per participant-minute in the shown conferencing configuration. As a hypothetical example, four participants each staying thirty minutes across one hundred sessions produce 12,000 participant-minutes; 2,000 beyond the stated allowance would be $8 at that displayed rate. This excludes every other charge and is not a quote.

Streaming is metered per viewer, with separate encoding minutes. Recording, transcription, summaries and RTMP output have their own allowances and rates. Audio-only and SD/HD selections can change pricing; the page’s dynamic calculator contains inconsistent text in the retrieved view, so its sample total is not reused. Confirm selected rates, currency, billing and support in the account.
sections.zh:
定价页每月包含 10,000 会议分钟，所示会议配置超出后为每参与者分钟 $0.004。举例，四人每次各停留三十分钟，共一百场，产生 12,000 参与者分钟；超过所列额度的 2,000 分钟按该费率为 $8。此例未含任何其他费用，不是报价。

直播按观看者计量，编码分钟另计。录制、转写、摘要及 RTMP 输出有各自额度与费率。纯音频及 SD/HD 选择可能改变费用；读取到的动态计算器文本存在不一致，本文未采用其示例总额。应在账户确认选择费率、货币、账单及支持条件。

sections.title_en: A managed service still needs application recovery
sections.title_zh: 托管服务仍需要应用侧恢复
sections.en:
Prebuilt reduces UI integration work but the application still owns user identity, joining flow and what to do when a call fails. Recording and transcript availability must be evaluated separately from whether media connected. Do not promise that a recording exists merely because a room enabled the feature.

The support table distinguishes best-effort developer support from paid response packages and contract options. SLA text is not an independently observed uptime result. A BAA-related add-on is listed under developer support; it does not by itself establish suitability of an entire medical application. No network, latency, recording recovery or compliance test was run.
sections.zh:
Prebuilt 减少界面集成工作，但应用仍负责用户身份、加入流程及通话失败处理。录制与转写可用性必须与媒体连接分别评估，不能因为房间启用功能就承诺一定有录制。

支持表区分尽力提供的开发支持、付费响应档位及合同选项。SLA 文本不是独立观测的正常运行结果。开发支持下列有 BAA 相关附加项，不能据此认定完整医疗应用合规。未测试网络、延迟、录制恢复或合规。

sections.title_en: SDK and Prebuilt are different integration choices
sections.title_zh: SDK 与 Prebuilt 是不同集成选择
sections.en:
Developers needing in-application roles, layouts and workflows should evaluate the SDK/Prebuilt route against the maintenance they can support. A nontechnical team wanting only a meeting link may not need infrastructure integration. Documented hosted rooms do not establish a right to self-host the service or permissive licensing for every component.

The exact SDK release, repository licences, token handling, browser/device matrix, regional contract and restore procedures were not verified. Those are implementation gates for a selected application, not evidence that the public overview failed.
sections.zh:
需要应用内角色、布局及流程的开发者，应结合维护能力评估 SDK/Prebuilt。只需会议链接的非技术团队，可能无需基础设施集成。文档中的托管房间不能证明有自托管服务权或每个组件都采用宽松许可。

未核实具体 SDK 版本、仓库许可、令牌处理、浏览器/设备矩阵、地区合同及恢复流程。这些是具体应用的实施核对点，不能由公开概述直接推定。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: No SDK, role enforcement, token, device/network, recording, billing or recovery test was performed; exact component licences and region terms need verification.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试 SDK、角色执行、令牌、设备/网络、录制、账单或恢复；具体组件许可和地区条款需核实。
